business_problem: First American Data & Analytics needed a better way to support LLM-assisted extraction of structured fields from title and property documents because billions of unstructured property documents and historical title policies still required slow, expensive manual extraction across more than 100 fields.
solution_summary: First American Data & Analytics uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support LLM-assisted extraction of structured fields from title and property documents. The implementation replaced a legacy state where billions of unstructured property documents and historical title policies still required slow, expensive manual extraction across more than 100 fields. Public record document images and historical title policy images move through production data pipelines and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. MLflow, Model Serving, and Agent Bricks operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver page-level document classifications and extracted title data elements.
